checks.limit_source: project (buck UVLO/soft-start are ASSUMED; not published by Murata)

checks.corner: OKI5 x0.97, lead max, 40.0 C, dropout max
checks.limit_source: ESP32-WROOM-32E VDD 3.0-3.6 V [datasheet]; ESP32-WROOM-32E 802.11b TX peak 379 mA [datasheet]

checks.description: Power-down (idle): relays lose 12 V (below 9 V) before the ESP32 3.3 V falls below 3.0 V
checks.limit_source: project: hardware drops the TEC relays while logic is still valid
checks.detail: 12 V < 9 V at 48.5 ms, 3V3 < 3.0 V at 133.7 ms after unplug

checks.description: Power-down (idle): 3.3 V decays without rebounding (largest rebound)
checks.limit_source: project: no supply bounce that could re-run the ESP32 boot

checks.description: Power-down (pull-down 100 W DPS load): relays lose 12 V (below 9 V) before the ESP32 3.3 V falls below 3.0 V
checks.limit_source: project: hardware drops the TEC relays while logic is still valid
checks.detail: 12 V < 9 V at 1.1 ms, 3V3 < 3.0 V at 1.9 ms after unplug

checks.description: Power-down (pull-down 100 W DPS load): 3.3 V decays without rebounding (largest rebound)
checks.limit_source: project: no supply bounce that could re-run the ESP32 boot

checks.description: USB-only (brick unplugged): reverse current from the DevKit through the OR-ing Schottky into the 5 V buck output
checks.limit_source: 1N5817/1N5819 IR max 1 mA at 25 C (rated VR); project: no back-powering of the pwr card
checks.detail: pwr +5V rises to -0.02 V; ctrl 3V3 3.30 V

notes: Aux PTC trip over 50 ms with the DPS loaded: 12 V at the tec card falls from 11 V to 4.8 V (K2 40 % drop-out) in 8.8 ms; the 12 V regulator drops out when VAUX < ~14.5 V (assumed UVLO).
Aux PTC trip over 500 ms with the DPS loaded: 12 V at the tec card falls from 11 V to 4.8 V (K2 40 % drop-out) in 77.5 ms; the 12 V regulator drops out when VAUX < ~14.5 V (assumed UVLO).

Regulator UVLO thresholds are not published for the OKI-78SR or TRACO TSR (datasheet_values.json): turn-on 14.5 V (12 V) / 6.5 V (5 V) assumed; start-up times from part_models.csv (TSR 2: 20 ms datasheet, TSR 1: ~2 ms assumed from the 0.7 ms rise plot).
AMS1117 dropout is specified only at 0.8 A (1.1 V typ / 1.3 V max); the current dependence below 0.8 A is an assumption.
